title: Lesson 2.4: Best Practices for Network Defense

story.vex: A door left open by accident works just as well as one I break down. (Commander Vex, Planet Doom)
story.victory: DOOM ATTACK REPELLED before it started: the forgotten door is closed and the warning signs are read. Astro: "Four habits, done every week. That's the whole job."

files.C:\\Citadel\\README.txt:
ORDERS FROM ASTRO
=================
Read review-notes.txt. Then: disable the unused diagnostic account (least privilege), close the stale test port, and read the flagged access log.

1. type review-notes.txt
2. net user diag-test /active:no
3. taskkill /im testport.exe /f
4. type logs\access-flagged.log
files.C:\\Citadel\\review-notes.txt:
WEEKLY REVIEW NOTES
---------------------
1. Account 'diag-test' has admin rights, unused for a year. Least privilege says shrink or disable it.
2. Port 6060 still listens from a test three months ago. Close it.
3. logs\access-flagged.log has unreviewed failed login attempts. Read it.
